# @dxtmisha/media

> Media resources and geographical dataset library for DXT UI — 250+ vector SVG country flags and ISO 3166-1 country metadata.

Framework-agnostic, tree-shakeable, zero-dependency library providing vector country flags and structured country information (phone codes, phone masks, timezones, primary languages, and first day of the week).

## Key Exports & Modules

- [geo](src/media/geo.ts): Comprehensive geographical dataset containing ISO 3166-1 country metadata.
- [flags](src/flags.ts): 250+ SVG country flag exports in PascalCase (`UsSvg`, `FrSvg`, `DeSvg`, `VnSvg`, `RuSvg`, etc.).
- [library.ts](src/library.ts): Main library barrel exporting datasets and helpers.

## Optional

- [README.md](README.md): Quick start guide and usage patterns.
- [package.json](package.json): Package exports mapping (`@dxtmisha/media/flags`).
